controls.scope: Additional required-pair context check, outside the four canonical ASK; true means cleaning context not evaluable, never OWL inconsistency or observed contamination.

Additional lot-operation-process and plan context integrity control, outside the four canonical ASK. True means a declared activity, contribution or plan activity lacks a matching manufacturing process; not OWL inconsistency.

One numeric energy and one selected factor IRI per matching lot/process operation. Value-equivalent literals count once. Contradictions block numeric inference; missing data is separately not evaluable. Foreign links remain visible through CCTX and are excluded from the numeric scope. Totals require every selected same-process operation, never a partial sum.

C030_R04.effect: Classify HighImpactIndicator only when its value exceeds an explicitly linked ThresholdRecord matching the same unit and category. Tuple fields belong to the same threshold IRI.
C030_R04.threshold_scope: Hypothetical declared scenario value, not normative threshold or measured industrial limit
C030_R04.OWL_constraint: thresholdValue/thresholdUnit/thresholdCategory are functional: at most one value, not an existence guarantee. Numerically equivalent decimal values are compatible; unequal values contradict OWL.

C031_R15.effect: Only ACTIVE maintenance in the declared snapshot classifies temporarilyUnavailable. PLANNED, COMPLETED, missing status or another resource do not.
C031_R15.time_scope: No date-based activation or automatic retraction; rebuild a new snapshot after status changes. Class inference accumulates.

C032_numeric.input: One nonnegative numeric energy value and exactly one selected electricity factor IRI per operation. One nonnegative numeric factor value, explicit kg CO2e/kWh unit. The selected IRI is the declared scenario current factor, without automatic version selection.
C032_numeric.scope: Matching lot→process→operation. Foreign-process edges are excluded and independently exposed by CCTX. Orphan records do not invalidate an unrelated lot.
C032_numeric.equivalence: Numeric equality, not RDF term identity or COUNT literals. Factor IRIs remain distinct selections even when their numeric values match.
C032_numeric.output: One numeric GHG amount per operation, agreeing with energy×factor. Arithmetic agreement tolerance 1e-9 is computational; input uniqueness uses exact numeric equality.
C032_numeric.aggregation: Validate uniqueness, then MIN chooses one representative numeric value per operation. SUM retains equal amounts from different operation IRIs. A selected incomplete operation prevents a complete lot/process total, rather than being dropped silently.
C032_numeric.preparation: CNUM-materialize.sparql marks NumericInputValid on valid input. It creates no individuals and is an explicit snapshot preparation, not an OWL axiom or SWRL conclusion. R01/R21 require this marker.

states.VALID: All scoped inputs are evaluable; after inference all operation outputs are coherent.
states.AMBIGUOUS_INPUT: Conflicting energy/factor/contribution numeric values, or more than one selected factor IRI. Block numeric inference before SWRL.
states.NOT_EVALUABLE: Missing, negative or unit-incompatible values, missing/mismatched post-inference output. Preserve structural validation and informational missing-data status; numerical totals are not certified.
states.NOT_APPLICABLE: No integrated numerical operation scope or configuration intentionally lacks that capability.

C032_numeric.configuration_flag: numeric_controls_enabled is true only in integrated/h3_extended

C033_C26.effect: Each required cleaning pair has one numeric lot-A end and one numeric lot-B start. Missing or conflicting endpoints yield NOT_EVALUABLE; equivalent100/100.0 values count once.
C033_C26.time_origin: Negative seconds are permitted with a common arbitrary origin. Ordering, not sign, determines validity.
C033_C26.equipment: Every shared equipment must have a coherent cleaning record inside the unique interval; unshared equipment is outside this pair.
C033_C26.relationship_to_R26: C26 evaluates the pair context separately. R26 false cannot certify cleaning if C26 is true. No physical contamination is inferred.

execution_evidence: No new engine/query execution is claimed by this authored contract; the runtime agent produces separate receipts.
